data.cultural_impact: The name Dheepta holds significant cultural relevance as it is rooted in Hindu mythology and symbolism. The use of the word 'dheepa' or deepak, with its association with light and illumination, reflects the Hindu belief in the importance of knowledge, learning, and wisdom. In Hindu rituals and practices, deepaks (oil lamps) are used to symbolize the inner light of the soul and to dispel darkness and ignorance.
